simple-board.title: Simple board
simple-board.keywords: one column per stage, one card per deal, count and value, Monday morning, who to call
simple-board.script: A deal board is simple. One column for each stage: New, Meeting, Proposal and Won. Each deal is one card. On top of each column you see how many deals sit there and what they are worth together. Imagine a Monday morning with this board in front of you. Two deals are in Proposal and one is stuck in Meeting. You know exactly who to call, and in which order.

track-every-deal.title: Track every deal
track-every-deal.keywords: one step at a time, nothing in your head, stuck column, empty column, a minute not a quarter
track-every-deal.script: Then you track every deal. A card moves one step at a time, from one column to the next. Nothing lives only in your head, and nothing gets forgotten. This is also how you find problems. A column that fills up and never empties tells you where deals get stuck. A column that stays empty tells you where you have no flow. You cannot see either from your inbox. When something is stuck, you see it in a minute instead of finding out in a quarter.

start-simple.title: Start simple
start-simple.keywords: no perfect tool, spreadsheet, sticky notes, weekly habit, fifteen minutes, small and regular
start-simple.script: Do not wait for the perfect tool. A spreadsheet works. Sticky notes on a wall work. The tool matters much less than the habit of updating it every week. Pick a weekly slot, fifteen minutes. Move the cards, add the new ones, remove the dead ones. Small and regular beats big and rare.
